verdict.rationale: Bulk operations (such as batch refunds, captures or payouts) are a fair axis for a payments API platform, but the evidence documents no batch or bulk-action endpoint, file upload, or MCP bulk tool. What it does show is adjacent: single-payment operations, idempotent retries, and reconciliation reports. None of these is a product capability for acting on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
